title: COLAB_SINGLE_FILE.ipynb

canonical_node.axiom: A single self-contained notebook must include all code, definitions, tests, and visualization required to reproduce results without external dependencies.
definitions: Single-file deployment: a notebook that contains all necessary components and requires no external files or imports.
External dependency: any file, module, or package not included within the notebook itself.
Reproducibility: the ability to obtain the same results by running all cells in the notebook in a standard Colab environment.
derivation: The document states that COLAB_SINGLE_FILE.ipynb includes everything: constants, class definitions, test implementations, and visualization.
It asserts that uploading the notebook to any Google Colab instance and running all cells yields full results without other files.
It claims zero external dependencies and immunity to version drift between files.
It positions the notebook as the paper equivalent for computational science, providing accessibility and portability.
canonical_node.action: Deploy the single-file notebook as the canonical distribution artifact for first-contact and sharing, ensuring it runs end-to-end in Google Colab with no external dependencies.
boundary: Does not claim to replace the modular architecture of COLAB_MASTER.ipynb for ongoing development.
Does not assert that the notebook is optimized for maintainability or ease of modification.
Does not guarantee that the notebook's results are correct or verified; it only claims self-containment.
test: Upload the notebook to a fresh Google Colab instance and run all cells without adding any external files.
Verify that all expected outputs, including test results and visualizations, are produced without errors.
Check that no import statements reference external modules not included in the notebook.

dg1_dependencies: No external files or modules required
dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a single-file, zero-dependency distribution method for the Theophysics project, enabling easy sharing and first-contact reproduction.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the ability to run all tests and visualizations in a standard Colab environment without requiring repository setup.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: If this node is removed, the project loses its single-file distribution artifact, making sharing and first-contact reproduction more cumbersome but not invalidating the underlying science.

classification.recommended_atom_action: Preserve as a distribution artifact; do not treat as evidence for scientific claims.

overstatement_risks: May be misinterpreted as providing proof of the underlying physics claims.
The claim of 'full results' may be overstated if the notebook contains errors or incomplete tests.
kill_conditions: If the notebook fails to run in a fresh Colab instance without external dependencies.
If the notebook omits critical components required for reproduction.
risk.lean_target: Formalize the notebook's self-containment as a deployment requirement, not as a scientific proof.

plain_summary: This document describes a single-file Colab notebook intended to be fully self-contained for easy sharing and reproduction. It does not provide scientific evidence or proofs; it is a distribution artifact. The node captures the requirement that the notebook must run without external dependencies, but does not validate the underlying claims.
